company.description: ProhostAI develops an AI-powered system to automate vacation rental guest communications and operations. By leveraging AI-driven solutions, ProhostAI aims to automate various aspects of property management, such as tenant communication, maintenance requests, and financial management. Their technology seeks to improve efficiency, reduce operational costs, and enhance the overall experience for property managers and tenants alike.
